In this video we cover:
Polycab vs Giants: Can It Survive UltraTech & Adani’s Cable Push?
India’s cable industry is heating up as UltraTech and Adani make aggressive entries. While investor sentiment around Polycab dipped, the company bounced back with record Q1 FY26 results—revenue up 26%, profit up 49%.
This video explores why giants are entering cables, how Polycab is responding, and what lies ahead for the industry.
